source_basis: Official Broadcom xAPIs reference documentation, not a published API specification.

sources.operation: VCF Automation 9.1 operation index: GET Get All Projects and POST Create
Authorization header authentication shared by the named project operations

verified_facts: The Broadcom operation index labels this reference 9.1 and names Get All Projects and Create under Project.
Get All Projects is GET /project-service/api/projects with optional apiVersion, page, size, and $orderby inputs; apiVersion defaults to 2019-01-15, page to 0, and size to 500.
The successful list response is 200 PageOfProjects JSON with projects in content and page metadata including totalElements, totalPages, number, numberOfElements, first, last, and empty.
Create is POST /project-service/api/projects with required ProjectSpecification.name, optional description, and application/json content; success is 201 with the created Project.
Create documents 409 when a project with the name already exists.
Both named operations use an apiKey authentication value in the Authorization request header.
